matched_playbook.title: Commercial Owner-Occupant Direct Authority Playbook
matched_playbook.economic_driver: Direct Peer-to-Peer Decision Velocity (Zero corporate committee red tape; 48-to-72 hour proposal turnaround directly to the deed holder / Managing Partner).

pillar_2_decision_velocity.rationale: Direct executive authority: Single decision-maker; 48-72 hr close velocity.

pillar_3_regulatory_compliance.rationale: Client-facing professional standard; confidential data privacy protocols.

pillar_4_operational_density.rationale: Epicenter of existing operational cluster (Plano); 0-mile dispatch radius.

pillar_5_contract_ltv_margin.rationale: Multi-year institutional agreement (36 months); high LTV retention.

assessment.recommended_action: Autonomous Proposal Generation & Outbox Letter Staging (Official Letterhead HWB-COM-001)

safeguards.scope_demarcation: Janitorial specifications cover all designated private offices, conference rooms, restrooms, kitchenettes/break areas, reception lobbies, and common circulation corridors. Exterior grounds and parking lots are excluded unless expressly added via Exhibit Rider.
safeguards.access_and_keycard_governance: All security fobs, electronic access badges, and facility keys shall be cryptographically logged in the SigmaFidelity Chain-of-Custody register. Technicians are strictly prohibited from granting facility access to unvetted third parties.
safeguards.cross_contamination_prevention: Mandatory color-coded microfiber protocol (Red = Restroom Sanitary/Toilets, Blue = General Office Surfaces/Desks, Green = Kitchen/Food Prep, Yellow = High-Touch Fixtures/Doorknobs) utilizing EPA-registered hospital-grade disinfectant.
safeguards.periodic_deep_maintenance_schedule: Contract includes quarterly machine burnishing of VCT/hard surfaces and annual hot-water extraction of high-traffic carpet runners, coordinated 14 days in advance with facility management.
safeguards.price_escalation_clause: Annual automatic rate adjustment indexed to the Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U DFW MSA) or 3.0%, whichever is greater, to protect labor wage floors against inflationary drift.
safeguards.cancellation_terms: Mutual thirty (30) day written notice for cause, preceded by a formal ten (10) day cure period documented via the SigmaFidelity Digital Audit Portal.
